## **Bugs und Stabilität** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs und Stabilität.**
      10 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen bugs und stabilität.
      Review-Fenster: 07.07.2026 - 27.09.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Crashes oder Instabilität. Nur bei Volume-Spike oder nach einem Update als actionable werten; sonst oft Baseline-Rauschen.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _Rachel C_, 27.09.2026, 1/5: "I've used Forest for years as a pro member, but the recent UI updates have made it almost unusable. I've gone from using forest every day to barely opening the app, and unless the developers listen to consumer feedback and go back to the way things were, I'll be uninstalling the app. Such a shame, a great app completely ruined!"
            2. _hjgjkhfhgdsdfhgjklhfhdsrueytiu_, 18.09.2026, 1/5: "As a pro user for the last few years, it’s a shame to see forest just keep going downhill - from adding AI slop trees, constant buggy updates, and now finally the new UI which makes returning to the home screen after planting a tree multiple clicks, I’m writing a review to hopefully get things to change. It’s a big shame, I hope they get their act together and remember what the core idea about the app is about."
            3. _Silk14789_, 16.09.2026, 1/5: "The developers have forced a buggy and fastidious update that ruins the app for me. It seems they went for sth “aesthetic” and forgot this a productivity app. At least give us the option to use the old UI back!"
<!--/ir-theme-->
